headline_pain: How Much Rent Have You Paid?
primary_text: "I'm paying more in rent every year and getting nothing to show for it. Dead money." Do the maths on what you've paid over 5, 10, 15 years. Hurts, doesn't it? Every dollar in rent is a dollar that could've gone into your own warehouse. In Truganina, just off Princes Freeway, we're building brand-new industrial units specifically for small businesses like yours. Off-the-plan pricing means you secure today's price before the market moves again. Near West Gate Tunnel and Port of Melbourne. Isn't it time you stopped making your landlord rich?
description: Every rent payment could be building your equity — Truganina warehouses from $365/wk*.
